newsitem.title: FRANCE: Bomb wounds several at Algiers hotel - witnesses.
newsitem.headline: Bomb wounds several at Algiers hotel - witnesses.

text.p: A bomb exploded early on Tuesday in front of a hotel in central Algiers, wounding several people, eyewitnesses in the Algerian capital said.
They said the bomb, probably planted in a car, went off outside the Hotel d'Angleterre, badly damaging the building.
Eyewitnesses, speaking by telephone from Algiers, said they saw several people who had been wounded.
There was no official word on the explosion.

An estimated 50,000 people have died in violence pitting Moslem rebels against government forces since early 1992 when the authorities cancelled a general election in which radical Islamists had taken a commanding lead.
